text: The absence of any current requirement to present unconstrained portfolio risks in detail raises the question whether unconstrained mutual fund prospectuses provide the adequate, accurate, and explicit information required by Section 1(b)(1) of the Company Act.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: seems to raise the question of whether UMF prospectuses at present provide "adequate, accurate, and explicit information, fairly presented, concerning the character of [mutual fund] securities," as required by Section 1(b)(1) of the Company Act.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: unconstrained mutual fund prospectuses under existing disclosure requirements
